jobs.title: AVP Retirement & Wealth Strategy
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Global Wealth & Asset Management (GWAM) is a key growth segment for Manulife. We operate three different channels (Retail, Retirement and Institutional) and are a major player in North America, Asia and Europe.

Our Retirement & Wealth business serves over 6M customers worldwide, is a key contributor to GWAM earnings and is well positioned in all of our key markets.

Reporting to the Head of GWAM Strategy & Transformation, the AVP, Retirement & Wealth Strategy is a key member of the finance & strategy team and an important catalyst and contributor to the overall strategy, growth, and transformation of our global franchise. The role is trusted advisor to the entire Retirement & Wealth Leadership Team, providing key insights and information to drive the development and execution of our strategy.

Responsibilities

Analyze key business priorities and bring insights to generate executive action that creates value for Retirement & Wealth
Build & maintain the strategy for these channels and engage the global and regional Leadership Teams in strategy development discussions
Translate strategy into actionable priorities, working with regional Leadership Teams to drive execution and accountability.
Establish and drive cross-functional collaboration and engagement across these teams, focusing on execution and business readiness in support of the global Retirement & Wealth strategy
Partner with the Portfolio Governance & Oversight team to ensure the project book aligns with the agreed upon strategic roadmap
Work closely with Finance partners to monitor progress on strategy execution and delivery, identifying areas of intervention and required pivots where needed
Manage strategy professionals to drive the Retirement & Wealth strategy & transformation
Align with competitive and market intel to ensure the strategic goals are both aspirational and achievable
Lead the development of communications to the Board of Directors, Executive Leadership Team, Transformation Delivery Team and other senior audiences
Generate appropriate communications material for various external audiences like analyst meetings/calls, rating agency presentations, and external conferences
Assist in the development of internal Retirement & Wealth communications plan to effectively communicate progress against strategic priorities

Key Attributes And Behaviors

Minimum of 12 years of relevant, progressively senior experience, in Strategy, Transformation, or Consulting – with strong experience in the wealth and asset management industry
Ability to work independently, get to the relevant information and pierce through siloes
Ability to handle difficult situations, deal efficiently with escalation
Strong business acumen and comprehensive knowledge of the Retirement & Wealth operating model in North America
Ability to connect the dots and rapidly identify and surface the relevant patterns and issues
Politically astute, with strong situational sensitivity and ability to influence
Exceptional organization and project management skills
Emotional intelligence, with ability to demonstrate judgment, discretion and diplomacy
Ability to see pressures the leadership team faces in pushing the organization to change and find ways to lessen them
Result-oriented with an ability to multi-task, prioritize across multiple initiatives, drive accountability, and develop creative solutions where blueprints may not exist
Outstanding communication skills with proven ability to articulate complex business problems in simple and impactful words
Ability to develop a clear position / point of view on key questions and issues impacting the business
Experience managing teams, both directly, and indirectly through influence

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

If you are applying to this role in Massachusetts, please note the salary range is $156,700- $290,900 USD. Additionally, employees also have the opportunity to participate in incentive programs and earn incentive compensation tied to business and individual performance .

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: AVP Strategy - Intermediary, Product, Institutional
jobs.description:
Global Wealth & Asset Management (GWAM) is a key growth segment for Manulife, operating through Retail, Retirement and Institutional channels across North America, Asia and Europe. The business operates externally under the Manulife Investment Management brand and brings together distribution, product and public and private markets capabilities to help individual and institutional clients achieve their financial goals.

Reporting to the Head of GWAM Strategy and Transformation, the AVP, Strategy – Retail Intermediary, Product and Institutional is a strategic partner to the relevant business leadership teams and a senior member of the GWAM Strategy team. The role drives the strategic plans for three executive leaders: to frame growth choices, sharpen portfolio and investment decisions and translate strategic ambition into an executable roadmap.

The AVP will bring an independent, enterprise-wide perspective across North America Intermediary, Global Product and Institutional. Working across Distribution, Product, Investments, Finance and Transformation, the role will build confidence that strategic priorities are focused, appropriately resourced and capable of delivering measurable client, business and financial outcomes. This is an opportunity to shape choices across three interconnected mandates and see those choices through to tangible impact, while leading and developing strategy professionals.

Responsibilities

Frame the most consequential strategic choices, bringing evidence-based recommendations on growth opportunities, competitive positioning, portfolio priorities and investment trade-offs to drive executive decisions.
Lead the development and ongoing refinement of an integrated strategy that creates value to our target client segments and intermediary needs.
Translate strategy into a sequenced roadmap with clear business outcomes, accountable owners, milestones and measures of success; test delivery capacity, resource requirements and execution readiness with business, regional and functional leaders.
Provide strategic leadership on product and capability portfolio choices, including where to invest, build, partner, reposition, rationalize or exit.
Identify opportunities to connect Intermediary / Institutional distribution with the product and investment agenda, including capability commercialization, channel expansion, strategic partnerships and shared enablement.
Analyze industry dynamics, investor, advisor and institutional client needs, consultant and platform trends, competitor actions, product vehicles, pricing developments and emerging business models to identify opportunities, risks and implications for strategic choices.
Partner with Transformation and business leaders to align the book of work with strategic priorities and recommend sequencing or reprioritization when capital, capacity or dependencies require trade-offs.
Build execution confidence across business and functional teams by surfacing dependencies, resolving cross-functional barriers and escalating decisions when delivery, strategic alignment or expected outcomes are at risk.
Lead prioritization and governance of strategic initiative pipelines, evaluating strategic fit, commercial potential, economics, resource requirements, dependencies and execution readiness.
Work with Finance and business leaders to assess performance against strategic and financial outcomes, challenge underlying assumptions and recommend corrective action or strategic pivots when progress or expected benefits fall short.
Maintain a practical view of strategic priorities, milestones, risks, dependencies and results, making trade-offs explicit and identifying where clearer accountability or a change in direction is required.
Lead strategy discussions, decision sessions, leadership off-sites and annual planning processes across North America Intermediary, Global Product and Institutional.
Lead executive-ready strategic narratives for senior management, the Manulife Executive Leadership Team and the Board of Directors, clearly articulating choices, trade-offs, progress and execution risks.
Partner with business leaders and Communications to build understanding of strategic priorities, reinforce accountability and communicate progress against intended outcomes.
Lead and develop strategy professionals, setting a high bar for analytical rigour, commercial judgment, collaboration and executive influence.

Key Attributes and Behaviours

Minimum of 12 years of relevant, progressively senior experience in Strategy, Transformation, Corporate Development or Consulting, with strong wealth and asset management experience and a record of influencing senior business decisions and translating strategy into measurable results.
Broad knowledge of intermediary and institutional distribution, investment products, product economics and public and private markets capabilities.
Ability to connect client, market, distribution, product, investment, financial and operational insights and translate them into clear strategic choices and practical recommendations.
Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify the questions that matter and mobilize expertise across organizational boundaries.
Sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to address difficult issues, resolve competing priorities and escalate with clear options and recommendations.
Executive presence and credibility to serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders, constructively challenge established thinking and build alignment without relying on formal authority.
Strong execution judgment, including the ability to assess roadmap feasibility, delivery capacity, dependencies and business readiness while maintaining focus on outcomes rather than activity.
Ability to form and defend an independent, evidence-based point of view on consequential business questions, while adapting recommendations as facts change.
Understanding of the business, financial and people impacts of change, with the ability to help leaders navigate trade-offs, strengthen readiness and sustain commitment to delivery.
Results-oriented leadership, with the discipline to prioritize across initiatives, make trade-offs explicit, drive accountability and develop practical solutions where blueprints do not exist.
Outstanding communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to articulate complex business problems and recommendations in clear, simple and impactful language.
Proven ability to lead and develop teams directly and mobilize senior cross-functional partners through influence across businesses and functions.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.
